- No file or content changes detected in this version.

Initial public release.

- Provides a full-stack AR/VR/WebAR/3D immersive marketing blueprint for high-visual/high-ticket products (furniture, art, decor, custom interiors).
- Outputs actionable strategies: experience design, asset specs/timeline, onsite flows/scripts, measurement plans, and KPI tracking.
- Requires understanding of user pain points (space, style, trust) and aligns AR/VR experiences to solve them for better conversion and fewer returns.
- Prescribes a step-by-step workflow: from defining experience focus to creating technical asset specs, journey mapping, content scripts, and ROI experiments.
- Integrates Rijoy’s AI-powered member/loyalty and structured feedback for value loop closure, turning immersive engagement into repurchase and advocacy.
- Ensures every output traces back to business impact, with templates for all deliverables.
